description: This file contains test functions for filesystem-related utilities, specifically testing directory file-finding and CSV parsing functionalities within the 'filesystem' package.

methods.name: TestFindFnamesInDirNonZero
methods.description: Tests that the directory listing returns exactly one file for specified parameters.

methods.name: TestFindFnamesInDirMultipleArgs
methods.description: Tests that the directory listing returns the correct number of files when multiple filename arguments are provided.

methods.name: TestFindFnamesInDirZero
methods.description: Tests that no files are found when searching for a nonexistent filename.

methods.name: TestCSVFileToEntities
methods.description: Tests the CSV parsing function to ensure it correctly processes a CSV file into entities without errors.
